claims.text: A downstream context is a conformist when it uses the upstream context's model as it is, with no translation of its own; the word also names that relationship on a context map.
claims.source_hint: Domain-Driven Design (Evans), Maintaining Model Integrity: Conformist

claims.text: Conformist, as a kind of relationship between bounded contexts, is a pattern name from Evans' Domain-Driven Design (strategic design).

claims.text: With JwtBearerOptions.MapInboundClaims left at its default (true), incoming JWT claim names such as sub are mapped to longer ClaimTypes URIs; setting it to false keeps the names as written in the token.

claims.text: Conforming costs nothing to build and suits a generic subdomain whose model fits yours (a UserId would only rename sub); its cost comes later, because every place that spells the upstream's names must change if those names change.

Translation pays when the outside model differs or changes outside your control. Role staff is exactly Đơn Hàng's staff, and while the team changes the realm only via its file in this repo (import is skipped once the realm exists), a rename arrives in a pull request.
